app.name: Dalail
onboarding.about1: Har jawab ulama ki likhi hui kitabon se liya gaya hai, aur dikhane se pehle ek aalim usay check karte hain.
onboarding.about2: Quran aur hadith bilkul usi tarah dikhaye jaate hain jaise maakhaz mein hain, hawalon ke saath.
onboarding.about3: Sab kuch offline chalta hai. Aap jo likhte hain woh aap ke phone se bahar nahi jaata.
onboarding.fullExplain: Aap ka phone Full mode chala sakta hai. Abhi Dalail phone par hi search karke jawab dhoondta hai; AI madadgaar baad ke update mein aayega.
onboarding.liteExplain: Aap ka phone Lite mode istemaal karega: tez search, AI madadgaar ke baghair. Saare jawab maujood hain.
onboarding.modelLater: AI model download (ikhtiyari): baad ke update mein.

results.noMatchBody: Yeh sawal Dalail ke kisi daawe se nahi mila. Aap mauzoo dekh sakte hain, ya sawal mehfooz kar sakte hain taake aainda update mein iska jawab shamil ho sake.
